$comment: RVLT contrast contract (DESIGN.md §3.8). Which token may draw text, pills, fills, actions and control boundaries on which surface, per theme. Every pairing listed is verified against tokens.json by tests/unit/token-contrast.test.mjs (WCAG 2.x; soft fills composited over the real surface). Pairings not listed are not supported. There are no accepted exceptions.

text.use: secondary body, table cells, icons by default
meta, captions, placeholders, stat labels, hour labels, future steps
red words: Kalam eyebrows, doodle notes, inline red emphasis. Not core red.
inline links; on light paper-2 use ink with an underline
standalone status words; on light paper-2 put the word in its pill

actions.use: primary, halo and destructive buttons, the live pill, the full-red CTA block
cream button and cream spotlight tier

nonText.use: input, select, textarea, combobox, checkbox and switch boundaries
focus ring, now ring, selection edge

moduleText: An active module item draws its label in ink; the hue carries the icon, the indicator and the soft fill.

binder.rule: Department hue draws the cue outline, leader and dash pattern (3:1 on the page). The department abbreviation and cue number are page-ink.
